lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines traversing the lateral torso; spacing is approximately equidistant in the mid-section with increased frequency and narrowing toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A singular Y-shaped bifurcation is observed on the fifth vertical line from the anterior, with the split occurring in the ventral half of the torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first anterior line is abbreviated, terminating mid-torso; several posterior lines near the rump exhibit truncation before reaching the dorsal or ventral boundaries.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low-density grouping of 3 distinct white spots visible on the upper lateral aspect of the hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the upper posterior haunch show a horizontal linear alignment relative to the pelvic axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking between the eyes and a cluster of two white spots on the lower cheek/mandible region.
